ensure.definition: To make certain that a required result happens or a required condition is met.
ensure.example: Please ensure that the form includes the reference number.

inform.definition: To give someone information about something.
inform.example: Please inform the team if the meeting time changes.

fields.definition: To bring items from several people or places into one group.
fields.example: Please collect one completed form from each team.

ensure_variant_correction: Use the final independent accepted_forms array ensure and insure. The older author candidate accepted only ensure and is not the accepted field source.
